note: Family-run for 30+ years, 5 miles south of Front Royal across from the Shenandoah River. RV sites with 20/30-amp water/electric (some creekside, some full hookup), plus tent sites, a group tent site and a tiny house, most along Gooney Creek; showers, flush toilets, dump station, swimming hole. Open April 1 through November 15 (2026). Multiple reviews note noise all night long from the nearby highway bridge. One review also claims no potable water for filling an RV tank if staying at primitive sites. Book on the operator's own booking page (gooneycreekcampground.com, 'Check Availability') or by phone. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own site and NewBook booking page: $48.50 base (E/W 20/30) to $63.50 full hookup, 30-amp, water and sewer, showers/flush toilets/dump, wifi (varies), reservable online. Changed season close 10-31 -> 11-15 (2026 season April 1 - November 15). Not stated by the operator: site count or max rig length (24 sites / 30 ft from the Hipcamp listing, left).
flags: Website is the Hipcamp listing (a booking platform); the operator's own site is https://www.gooneycreekcampground.com/ (it says 'This is the only official website for Gooney Creek Campground'), booking at https://bookingsus.newbook.cloud/gooneycreekcampground/index.php.

Phone: the operator's site gives (540) 692-9599; the entry has (540) 635-4066. The operator warns 'gooneycreek.com is outdated and includes an incorrect phone number' (that domain now redirects to mdisite.com).
Price gate: base $48.50/night (E/W 20/30) on the operator's booking page, just under US$50.
